question: How many seconds do I hold the reset pin to factory reset the Nimbus Hub H2?
why: The model answered, and the self-check agreed the cited passages support it.

citations.title: Nimbus Hub H2 Setup Guide
citations.text: The Nimbus Hub H2 connects to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi networks only. Install the Nimbus app, plug in the hub and wait for the light to pulse white, which means the hub is ready to pair. A solid amber light means the hub has no internet connection. To restore factory settings, press and hold the recessed reset pin for 8 seconds until the light flashes red twice. Resetting removes every paired device and the saved Wi-Fi password.

citations.title: Nimbus Hub H2 Troubleshooting
citations.text: If the hub shows a solid amber light, restart your router and then unplug the hub for 10 seconds. If the light stays amber, move the hub closer to the router and confirm the network is 2.4 GHz, because 5 GHz-only networks are not supported. A solid red light means the hub is in recovery mode; hold the button for 15 seconds while plugging in power to reload the last stable firmware. Do not cover the hub, because it can overheat.

question: What type of batteries does the Nimbus Lock L1 use?
why: The model answered, and the self-check agreed the cited passages support it.

citations.title: Nimbus Lock L1 Troubleshooting
citations.text: If the keypad does not respond, replace all four batteries first. If the app reports that the lock is jammed, open the door and hold the Nimbus button for 5 seconds to recalibrate the bolt. In an emergency, touch a 9 V battery to the contacts on the underside of the keypad to power the lock temporarily. A spare mechanical key is included only with units whose serial number starts with K.

citations.title: Nimbus Lock L1 Setup Guide
citations.text: The Nimbus Lock L1 runs on 4 AA alkaline batteries. Insert them with the door open, then hold the Nimbus button for 3 seconds to pair the lock with the Hub H2 over Bluetooth within 5 meters. Codes can be 4 to 8 digits. The auto-lock timer can be set to 30 seconds, 60 seconds or 5 minutes. The app shows a low battery warning when charge falls to 20 percent; expect about 9 months of battery life at 10 uses per day.

citations.title: Nimbus Hub Firmware 5.0 Release Notes
citations.text: Hub firmware 5.0 introduces local-only mode, which keeps video and automations on your home network. Local-only mode requires Cam C3 firmware 2.1 or later. Firmware 5.0 drops support for the discontinued Hub H1. Matter support is unchanged. The update takes about 8 minutes.

citations.title: Nimbus Cam C3 Privacy and Data Retention
citations.text: Clips are encrypted before they leave the camera. Clips on the microSD card are overwritten oldest first when the card is full. Cloud clips are deleted when they pass the history window of your cloud plan. When local-only mode is turned on, the camera stops uploading clips to the cloud entirely.
